summary: Reason I say this is because it seems they are treating it as main title and not a simple remake, they specifically mentioned differences from Breath of The Wild, it’s been 15 years since the last 3D Zelda with the previous structure, if they want to explore that again, having this as a gap game would be perfect for all generations of players.
